title: PEGL APP front
bodyHtml:
The ultimate goal of genetic association studies is to discover which genes and pathways have direct roles in risk of a disease or trait. Many disease-focused studies include predictions of the most likely effector (causal) genes for that disease, usually generated by considering multiple types of evidence.

 

 

These lists are valuable because they represent the current view of potential effector genes from experts in each disease community, but they are often difficult to find within the large number of supplementary files that accompany most publications. We are endeavoring to make these lists accessible and interactive within the Knowledge Portals (KPs). For more information on how to explore and interpret the lists, please see our tutorial.

Have you generated a list of predicted effector genes for a common disease or related trait? Please contact us to have the list displayed in the Knowledge Portals.
